Found the site's full Danish category tree via sitemap https://sostrenegrene.com/da/sitemap.xml (grepped all /produkter/...-c-NNNN category-page URLs, ~140 leaf/branch categories across Bolig, Accessories, Boern, Fest, Kreativitet, Skonhed, Mobler, Jul, Paske, etc.) -- exactly ONE category matches Pet Care: Accessories > Dyreartikler ('Animal articles/Pet accessories'), https://sostrenegrene.com/da/produkter/accessories/dyreartikler-c-8414, categoryId=66 (read from the page's embedded jsonContent.content.categoryId). No pet food, litter, beds, bowls, crates, carriers, toys, or grooming items found anywhere on the site. No pet-food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories present.
